scope: Native iPhone Simulator local workspace exit after actual local reminder delivery; normal signed-out relaunch and isolated workspace reopening

productionChange.behavior: Dismiss the presented Settings navigation stack when sign-in becomes false. A failed sign-out that retains sign-in does not dismiss it.

before.classification: Actual delivery and native workspace exit reached. Account settings remained presented over AuthView; the read-only inspector existed behind the sheet but its button was not hittable. Registry retirement was not established in this failed run.

accepted: Real native undated task capture with two absolute independent reminder occurrences
Actual background local notification reaches SpringBoard
Actual Account > Leave local workspace > Continue
Settings sheet dismisses and read-only inspector becomes hittable
Actual UNUserNotificationCenter pending and delivered registries are empty after exit
Normal process relaunch without uitesting/localMode arguments remains signed out with both registries empty
Explicit isolated workspace reopening preserves the entire parsed disk snapshot exactly
End fixture retires re-enabled pending occurrences; no queued edits

fixture.registryInspector: Read-only UNUserNotificationCenter queries. Visible only on signed-out dedicated Simulator Debug bundle with explicit --notification-signout-testing; no synthetic callback or handler invocation.

captures.workspace-exit.png: Inspected sign-in screen without stale Account sheet; inspector action usable. Debug inspector button caption ellipsizes; no product layout claim for it.
captures.signed-out-relaunch.png: Inspected signed-out relaunch without stale sheet.
captures.delivered-alert-animation.png: Delivery capture caught banner animation and is blurred. Real title existence is established by native SpringBoard assertion; this image is not visual alert-layout acceptance.

limitations: Local workspace exit is not authenticated account A > B or cross-account callback replay
No stale notification action was tapped after exit; both registries were already retired
No cold-process Complete, Mac notification action, APNs or physical device acceptance
Mac app is now accessible after manual unlock, but gallery access still needs the desktop Edit Widgets action; no installed-host pass
earlierBuildAttempt: signout-action-build-v1.log failed from a test helper parameter inserted at the wrong matching launch line; corrected before native runs; not a product defect
